title: Stored XSS through SVG uploads
impact: An authenticated user can upload active SVG content that executes when another user opens it in an executable browser context.

title: CSV formula injection in position exports
impact: Attacker-controlled position fields reach a CSV export. Spreadsheet software may interpret these values as formulas when another user opens the file.

title: XML injection in KML and GPX exports
impact: Device names are inserted into XML exports without the required escaping, allowing file structure manipulation and spoofed location content.

title: HTML injection in notification emails
impact: Names controlled by a low-privilege user are inserted into notification HTML, enabling misleading content and phishing in emails to other users.

title: OIDC authorization code theft through an open redirect
impact: Unvalidated redirect destinations in OIDC provider endpoints can send authorization codes to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

title: Path traversal in device image storage
impact: An absolute device identifier can cause an image upload to write outside the configured media directory. Impact depends on the server’s filesystem permissions.

title: CPU exhaustion in MIME parameter parsing
impact: Excessive RFC 2231 MIME parameters in a message cause excessive CPU use during LMTP mail delivery. The vendor identifies this as a resource-consumption issue.

title: Sieve CPU time limit bypass
impact: A user able to supply a Sieve script can cause processing to exceed the configured CPU time limit, degrading server performance.

title: CPU exhaustion in IMAP THREAD processing
impact: A crafted message header causes disproportionate CPU use when a mail client requests message threading for the affected mailbox.

title: Hash-collision CPU exhaustion in IMAP THREAD
impact: Crafted header values collide in an internal hash table. Message threading can exhaust CPU; the vendor identifies this as distinct from CVE-2026-40014.
